title: Objective: Complete Factory vNext self-hosted execution

acceptance: A controller-offline activation test observes exactly one durable activation after duplicate equivalent requests.
Read-only doctor, plan, status, and explain tests observe no GitHub mutation.

CLI and MCP contract tests expose equivalent doctor, plan, status, explain, pause, resume, drain, cloud-pause, retry, priority, replay, cancellation, controller start, controller stop, controller install, and controller uninstall operations.
Duplicate mutating-command tests return the original durable receipt.
MCP metadata tests verify correct read-only, destructive, and idempotency annotations.
conventions: Use Octokit for every GitHub API operation in src/.
Keep state derivable from GitHub records.
Route CLI and MCP handlers through the same typed application services.
Preserve legacy policy digests and v1 GitHub Copilot compatibility.
workItems.goal: Introduce an idempotent application-service boundary shared by chat/MCP and CLI for activation, inspection, run control, cancellation, replay requests, and controller lifecycle operations.
preconditions: Phase 0 protocol and policy foundations at the pinned base SHA remain authoritative.
GitHub writes continue to use the existing platform pacing, circuit-breaker, and concurrency controls.
workItems.title: Implement durable activation and complete CLI/MCP control surface

acceptance: Controller tests activate and fairly reconcile two Objectives without admitting the same Work Item twice.
Lease tests reject stale compare-and-swap generations before admission, publication, or integration.
Fault tests restart after each modeled lifecycle interruption and observe exactly-once durable admission and publication effects.
Repository-wide tests enforce shared pacing, budget, capacity, path-claim, and integration fencing across Objectives.
systemd lifecycle tests observe idempotent install, start, stop, restart, status, and uninstall behavior without leaving an enabled unit after uninstall.
conventions: Use repository-scoped fencing backed only by GitHub.
Make lifecycle operations explicit and idempotent.
Never persist reconstructable scheduler state in sidecar files.
Keep active work safe when new admission must fail closed.
workItems.goal: Run continuous, repository-scoped reconciliation with compare-and-swap fencing, fair multi-Objective discovery, shared limits, interruption recovery, and explicit idempotent Linux/WSL user-service management.
preconditions: The durable application-service activation contract is implemented.
A Linux or WSL systemd user instance is available only for the lifecycle integration gate.
workItems.title: Add fenced unattended repository controller and systemd lifecycle

acceptance: Golden fixtures compile repeatedly to byte-equivalent valid DAGs regardless of input enumeration order.
DAG validation rejects cycles, unobservable acceptance criteria, invalid scope entries, overlapping unordered scopes, invented commands, and impossible stack topology.
Repository-facts tests produce bounded context manifests and normalized execution profiles for TypeScript, generated-output, binary, deterministic-simulation, and visual-validation fixtures.
Compiler output records conflict classes, exclusive resources, validation tiers, delivery hints, and economic-review results without imposing a fixed Work Item count.
Management-backend tests reject malformed or unbounded structured output before it becomes a compiled Objective.
conventions: Keep compiler stages pure where practical.
Bound all repository context explicitly.
Use only repository-observed validation commands.
Require a dependency path for every overlapping scope pair.
workItems.goal: Compile Objectives through bounded, deterministic stages using repository facts, context manifests, conflict and resource analysis, validation design, delivery hints, and conservative economic review.
preconditions: The repository's declared scripts and checked-in files are the authoritative source for validation-command discovery.
workItems.title: Implement staged Objective compiler and repository profiles

acceptance: Priority fixtures observe stable project-field IDs, option IDs, and sub-issue ordering, and randomized input order yields identical ready ordering.
cgroup v1, cgroup v2, WSL fallback, malformed-input, cache-expiry, pressure, and cooldown tests select the tightest observable resource limit and fail closed only for new admissions.
Capacity tests reject stale generations and over-reservation, reconstruct reservations after restart, and release each terminal reservation exactly once.
Admission matrices prove that no selected work exceeds lease, policy, budget, capacity, path, resource, trust, or backend constraints.
Temporary saturation produces a queued reason without creating an attempt or consuming retry budget.

With burst disabled, local-compatible work never selects a paid backend; with explicit immutable authority, cloud selection remains within provider, native-unit budget, concurrency, TTL, egress, and trust limits.
Continuous-refill tests keep available safe slots occupied while preserving multi-Objective fairness.
conventions: Keep ordering and admission planners free of I/O and wall-clock reads by injecting snapshots.
Default to adaptive local execution with burst mode never.
Never broaden authority during retry or recovery.
Record stable structured reasons for every queued or selected decision.
workItems.goal: Provide GitHub-derived priority, pure graph scoring, cgroup-aware resource sampling, repository-wide capacity accounting, work-conserving local-first admission, and immutable-authority cloud-burst decisions.
preconditions: Repository-controller fencing and continuous reconciliation are implemented.
Compiled Work Items expose normalized resource, scope, trust, validation, and delivery evidence.
workItems.title: Implement deterministic adaptive admission and bounded cloud burst

acceptance: Backend conformance tests pass unchanged against both App Server and CLI adapters.
Concurrent-session tests observe isolated thread identities, worktrees, Codex homes, progress events, and artifacts.
Restart tests resume a durable thread or produce one explicit safe reconciliation outcome without duplicate execution.
Cancellation tests terminate the owned session and record a durable terminal outcome.
Unattended approval tests prove that an approval request cannot leave an attempt hanging.
Usage normalization tests emit the same public accounting shape for both adapters.
conventions: Preserve isolated Codex homes and worktrees.
Use identical artifact and validation contracts across adapters.
Normalize usage conservatively and report unavailable values as unavailable.
Fence cancellation and recovery with durable attempt identity.
workItems.goal: Support isolated, resumable App Server-backed local Codex sessions while retaining the CLI fallback and an identical worker, artifact, validation, cancellation, and security boundary.
preconditions: The existing CLI local adapter remains the compatibility fallback.
workItems.title: Add durable Codex App Server execution adapter

acceptance: Topology tests produce deterministic sibling, linear, diamond, and join delivery plans or an explicit unsupported result.
Capability-probe tests select native stacks only from observed repository support and record why regular pull requests were selected otherwise.
Publication fault tests recover idempotently from partial branch, pull-request, receipt, rebase, merge-queue, and asynchronous-merge states.
A lower-layer head change invalidates every affected descendant validation before publication or integration.
Every integration test verifies independent validation evidence names the exact published head SHA.
Integration-lease tests reject stale heads and make retry, cancellation, and rollback effects idempotent and reversible.
conventions: Use Octokit for GitHub operations.
Treat publication and integration as receipt-backed asynchronous state machines.
Revalidate after every head-changing rebase.
Record regular-PR fallback before selecting it.
workItems.goal: Plan and publish sibling or stacked pull requests with capability probing, exact-head validation, cascading invalidation, asynchronous integration, recovery, and an evidenced regular-PR fallback.
outOfScope: Assuming native stack support without probing.
Live GitHub conformance without separately available repository authority.
preconditions: Execution adapters emit the shared artifact and validation contracts.
Compiled Work Items include deterministic delivery hints.
workItems.title: Implement provider-neutral delivery and native stacked pull requests

acceptance: Replay tests reproduce every admission and queued decision from a pinned deterministic conformance fixture.
Explain tests identify the exact dependency, capacity, authority, priority, scope, trust, backend, validation, or economic gate using stable reason codes.

Status tests show effective ready order, configured and observed capacity, active reservations, queuedSince, priority source, burst trigger, and reserved and remaining budget without credentials or raw provider responses.
Duration feedback uses only matching evidenced historical samples and remains conservative when evidence is sparse.
Unavailable usage or billing data is emitted as unavailable and is never presented as a measured or estimated fact.
Run summaries reconcile attempts, validation, delivery, native-unit budget, and terminal outcomes from durable GitHub evidence.
conventions: Make replay functions pure over pinned input snapshots.
Keep reason-code identifiers stable.
Exclude credentials and unnecessary machine identifiers from public records.
Distinguish observed, conservatively estimated, and unavailable values.
workItems.goal: Reproduce scheduling decisions from pinned snapshots and expose stable reason codes, run summaries, usage and cost accounting, and evidence-backed duration feedback without mandatory telemetry.
preconditions: Adaptive admission emits complete structured decision evidence.
Execution and delivery adapters emit durable normalized receipts.
workItems.title: Add pure replay, explanations, and conservative economic feedback

acceptance: Typechecking and the complete test suite pass.
Package verification rebuilds and starts both committed executables successfully.
Production dependency audit reports no production vulnerabilities.
A clean plugin-installation test exercises the packaged controller and MCP entry points rather than a worktree configuration.
Manifest validation observes consistent executable and skill declarations across supported plugin manifests.
Conformance documentation links every claimed release-definition-of-done statement to executable evidence.
Live GitHub, Linux/WSL, and paid-provider gates lacking executed evidence remain explicitly unclaimed, and paid-provider claims remain gated on separate spend authorization.
Legacy v2 fixtures and policy digests, active-run parsing, and v1 GitHub Copilot compatibility tests continue to pass.
conventions: Exercise Factory through the installed plugin.
Commit rebuilt distribution artifacts.
Keep documentation claims no stronger than recorded evidence.
Retain local execution as the default and paid burst as disabled.
workItems.goal: Ship an installable vNext surface whose public claims, manifests, schemas, bundled executables, skill instructions, deterministic gates, and explicitly unclaimed live gates agree exactly.
outOfScope: Executing paid-provider conformance without spend authorization.
Claiming unexecuted GitHub or host lifecycle behavior.
Adding a hosted Factory service, GitHub Action, custom UI, private database, or queue.
Embedding credentials or private deployment details.
preconditions: All implementation Work Items have landed with deterministic evidence.
Any live or paid conformance claim is made only after its separate gate actually runs with explicit authority.
workItems.title: Align installable plugin, documentation, schemas, bundles, and conformance
